title: Premium Payment Terms for Ashgrove CareAssure Policies
content:
Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance (Ashgrove CareAssure) is offered with two premium payment options in every tier: a single premium, or ten-pay premiums payable over a fixed number of policy years. Ten-pay premiums are payable in annual mode or by monthly electronic funds transfer (EFT) draft.

**Premium accounting terms by tier**

| Term | 2-Year | 3-Year | 4-Year | 5-Year | 6-Year | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Premium payment options | Single, ten-pay | Single, ten-pay | Single, ten-pay | Single, ten-pay | Single, ten-pay | Single, ten-pay |
| Policy years premiums are payable under ten-pay | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Annual premium multiplier, annual mode | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Annual premium multiplier for each monthly EFT draft | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 |
| Latest EFT draft day of the month | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 | 28 |
| Shortfall up to which a remittance is applied as full payment | $2.00 | $2.00 | $2.00 | $2.00 | $2.00 | $2.00 |
| Unapplied money refunded when above | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 |

### How the terms read

- **Annual mode.** The installment is the annual premium multiplied by 1.00, that is the annual premium itself.
- **Monthly EFT.** Each monthly draft is the annual premium multiplied by 0.0875 (8.75 percent). Twelve such drafts together come to 1.05 times the annual premium.
- **Draft day.** A monthly EFT draft falls on a day of the month from the 1st to the 28th.
- **Shortfall tolerance.** A remittance that falls short of the installment by $2.00 or less is applied as full payment; a shortfall of more than $2.00 is not covered by this tolerance.
- **Overpayment.** Unapplied money held above $25.00 is refunded.

### Illustration (hypothetical annual premium)

| Hypothetical annual premium | Annual-mode installment | Monthly EFT draft | Twelve drafts in total |
|---|---|---|---|
| $4000.00 | $4000.00 | $350.00 | $4200.00 |
| $6400.00 | $6400.00 | $560.00 | $6720.00 |

On the $350.00 draft, a hypothetical remittance of $348.00 is short by $2.00 and is applied as full payment; a remittance of $347.50 is short by $2.50 and is not.
